user.title: DomoLink-Tado Connection
user.description:
Please link your Tado account using the official secure Device Flow protocol.

1. Open the link: [{verification_uri}]({verification_uri})
2. Enter the following code if prompted: **{user_code}**
3. Confirm access on your Tado account, then click the blue **Submit** button below.

data.home_id: Home ID (Optional - Auto-detected via your Tado account)

manual_home.title: Direct Home ID Entry (Bypass Rate Limit)
manual_home.description:
Your Tado authentication succeeded, but Tado servers are currently rate-limiting your requests (100 req/day standard quota).

To complete setup immediately without waiting for your quota to reset, please provide your **Home ID**:

- Open [{tado_url}]({tado_url}) in your browser: the ID number is visible in your URL bar after `/home/` (e.g. `https://my.tado.com/webapp/#/home/123456/`).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate DomoLink-Tado
reauth_confirm.description:
Please renew your Tado authorization using the official secure Device Flow protocol.

1. Open the link: [{verification_uri}]({verification_uri})
2. Enter the following code if prompted: **{user_code}**
3. Confirm access on your Tado account, then click the blue **Submit** button below.

labels.title: Room Labels & Tags
labels.description: Assign custom labels/tags to your rooms to easily filter them on the dashboard (e.g. Ground Floor, Upstairs, Bedrooms, Living Rooms). Separate multiple tags with commas.

error.authorization_pending: Authorization pending on Tado. Please authorize access on the Tado web page, then click Submit below.
error.code_expired: Device code has expired. A new code has been generated, please open the new link above.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect or authenticate with Tado. A new code has been generated, please open the link above.
error.rate_limit: Tado servers are temporarily rate-limited (429 Too Many Requests). Please wait 30 to 60 seconds before clicking Submit again.
error.invalid_home_id: Home ID must be a valid positive integer.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Tado account is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.no_homes_found: No Tado home found for this account.
abort.cannot_start_flow: Unable to initiate Device Flow with Tado.

data.external_sensors_trigger: 🌡️ Configure external temperature & humidity sensors per room
data.auto_offset_calibration: Automatic physical valve offset calibration via external sensor (0.5°C deadband, 30 min cooldown)
data.auto_window_enabled: Open window detection: automatically turn off heating
data.dynamic_window_drop: Dynamic rapid thermal drop detection (window open)
data.adaptive_polling: Smart adaptive polling (60s active heating, 5m idle)
data.outdoor_weather_entity: Outdoor weather entity for ventilation advice (e.g. weather.home)
data.geofencing_persons: Person/tracker entities to track (e.g. person.john, person.mary or empty for zone.home)

external_sensors.title: External sensors per room
external_sensors.description: Specify Home Assistant entity IDs (e.g. sensor.living_room_temperature, sensor.living_room_humidity) to override Tado measurements and auto-calibrate valve offsets.
